hypothesis: Exact-C gains representation from auxiliary failure subtypes, but ordinary MultiClass devotes equal row loss to separating those subtypes even though the competition only scores the success marginal. Uniformly reducing every failure-class training weight, followed by the engine's exact prior-unweighting step, may retain auxiliary structure while allocating more tree capacity to success versus failure.

novelty_audit.prior_weighted_run: v4_outcome_weight_failure used unequal weights [middle=1.5, reverse=1.1, success=1.0, wide=1.25] on 2024 only, which emphasized failure distinctions rather than success separation.
novelty_audit.current_direction: All failure subclasses receive one common weight below one, so their internal relative prior is unchanged.
novelty_audit.multiseed_and_regularization_not_repeate: Seed bagging and global L2/border regularization are separate closed families.

candidate_family.class_prior_correction: Divide predicted class probabilities by their training class weights and renormalize before summing success classes; already implemented in fit_outcome_model.
